|hatnote=For the parallel numbered black-on-white print option, see [[Prophetess (V) (Virtual Set 1) (Errata)]]. For the earlier unnumbered slip, see [[Prophetess (V) (Virtual Set 1)]]. For the later PC remastered publication, see [[Prophetess (V) (Virtual Set 1) (Errata 2)]].
|notes=This is the numbered white-on-black presentation of Prophetess (V). The Players Committee distributed it as Virtual Set #1a through Decipher. Both numbered PDFs record creation on 6 March 2002 and state tournament legality from 9 March. The numbered sheets print collector mark 1•8 with identical words and game values in the two ink layouts. The 2006 wording expressly identifies the chosen opponent’s deck or pile as the object of the optional shuffle. Other editions include [[Prophetess (V) (Virtual Set 1: Legacy) (Original unnumbered)|Original (unnumbered)]], [[Prophetess (V) (Virtual Set 1: Legacy) (Numbered black-on-white)|Numbered (black-on-white)]], [[Prophetess (V) (Virtual Set 1: Legacy) (Premium)|Premium]], [[Prophetess (V) (Virtual Set 1: Legacy) (Remastered 2006)|Remastered (2006)]].
|sources=* [[Media:Decipher-Virtual-Set-1a-numbered.pdf|Numbered Virtual Set #1a source PDF]], [[Players Committee]], distributed through [[Decipher]], page 1, collector label 1•8. The numbered white-on-black slip supplies the game text and any covered statistics. The article image is a direct rasterized crop of this source sheet.
* [[Media:Decipher-Virtual-Set-1-numbered.pdf|Numbered Virtual Set #1 source PDF]], page 1, collector label 1•8, for the same wording and numerical values in the black-on-white print option.
* Lore, destiny, upper-card attributes and other uncovered information: the printed Premiere [[Prophetess]], [[:File:Premiere-D-prophetess-decipher-archive.gif|Decipher source face]]. The Virtual slip replaces the covered portion only.
* Character landspeed: [[Media:Decipher Rulebook 2.0.pdf|Decipher Rulebook 2.0]], PDF page 10, “Landspeed”: characters have landspeed of 1. This is a rule-derived value, not a printed value on the slip.
